App.Title: SaveHarbor
Paths.ShowTooltip: Show the save file in File Explorer
Header.LatestTooltip: The newest published cloud save version.
Header.GameTooltip: Shows whether the game appears to be running. Save operations are blocked while the game is open.
World.RefreshTooltip: Scan the game save folder again and refresh world/backup status.
Actions.BackupTooltip: Create a zip backup of the selected world. The game must be closed.
Actions.RestoreTooltip: Replace the selected local world from a SaveHarbor backup. A safety backup is created first.
Actions.ImportTooltip: Import a world from a SaveHarbor backup or from a save file from anywhere, such as one a friend sent you. You see what it contains before anything changes, and your current copy is backed up first.
Actions.SetupCloudTooltip: Change where this group shares its worlds: the SaveHarbor Cloud group, or the shared Google Drive folder.
Actions.ConnectTooltip: Connect SaveHarbor to your group's cloud. You sign in once; later starts reuse the saved sign-in.
Actions.CheckTooltip: Check the cloud manifest, latest version, and active session state.
Actions.UploadTooltip: Upload the selected local world to the cloud provider. Upload is blocked if cloud changed while you played.
Actions.DownloadTooltip: Download the latest cloud save. If a local world is selected, SaveHarbor creates a safety backup before restore; if no local world exists, it imports the cloud save into your profile.
Actions.StartSessionTooltip: Mark that you are starting to play from the current cloud version, so friends see an active session warning.
Actions.EndSessionTooltip: Clear your active session lock if you stop playing without uploading.
Dialog.ConfirmRemoval: This removes a world save. Please read carefully.
CloudSetup.Title: Google Drive folder setup
CloudSetup.Subtitle: Use one shared folder for your group. Everyone signs in with their own Google account, but reads and writes this same folder.
CloudSetup.FolderLinkTooltip: Paste the Google Drive folder URL or the folder ID from the URL. The folder must be shared with edit access.
CloudSetup.Help: Create a folder in Google Drive, share it with your friends as editors, then paste its folder link here. SaveHarbor remembers every folder you save, so you can switch back from the list above. Use a separate folder for each game.
CloudSetup.Ready: Paste the shared folder link, then test access.
CloudSetup.SavedFoldersTooltip: Pick a shared folder this PC has used before. SaveHarbor tests it straight away.
CloudSetup.ForgetTooltip: Remove this folder from the list on this PC. Nothing in Google Drive changes.
CloudSetup.Forgotten: "{0}" was removed from the list. Nothing in Google Drive changed.
CloudProviderChoice.Title: Choose how to share your worlds
CloudProviderChoice.Subtitle: Your group shares its worlds through one of these. You can switch later in Settings.
CloudProviderChoice.SupabaseDescription: Sign in with an e-mail code and join your group with an invite code. Fastest, and shows who is playing.
CloudProviderChoice.GoogleDriveDescripti: Use a shared Google Drive folder. Needs a Google account that the group owner has allowed.
CloudGroup.Title: SaveHarbor Cloud
CloudGroup.Subtitle: Sign in with your e-mail address, then join or create the group you share worlds with.
CloudGroup.EmailHint: We only use this to sign you in. No password, no newsletter.
CloudGroup.CodeHint: Enter the code from the e-mail. You can also paste it.
CloudGroup.CreateHint: You become the group's owner and get an invite code for your friends.
CloudGroup.CreatedHint: Send this to your friends. Anyone with the code can join.
Sharing.ActionTooltip: The next step for sharing this game's worlds with your group.
Shell.NoWorlds: No worlds on this PC yet. Create a world in the game, or connect the cloud and download your group's world from the list below.
Shell.ChooseWorldHint: Pick a world on the left to see its sharing status and play it.
Shell.CloudOnlyHint: Shared by your group but not on this PC yet.
Shell.DownloadWorldTooltip: Add this shared world to this PC. No existing world is changed.
Shell.ThisPcTooltip: The cloud version this PC last uploaded or downloaded, and whether the world was played since.
Shell.DirectionTooltip: → this PC has the newer copy · ← the cloud has the newer copy · = both are the same · ≠ both changed
Shell.RecommendedActionTooltip: The action that brings this PC and the cloud back in line. SaveHarbor backs up your world first.
Shell.RemoveFromPcTooltip: Back up this world, then delete it from the game folder on this PC. The cloud copy is not touched.
Shell.RemoveFromCloudTooltip: Keep the latest version as a backup, then remove this world from the shared folder for everyone. Copies on PCs are not touched.
Shell.OtherWorldBackupsHint: Every other world, including ones no longer on this PC. "Restore as world" brings one back.
Shell.RestoreAsWorldTooltip: Put this backup back as its own world. If that world exists, SaveHarbor backs it up first and asks before replacing it.
Shell.RestoreThisTooltip: Put this backup back in place of the world. The current copy is backed up first.
Shell.AllWorldInfoTooltip: Everything SaveHarbor can read from this world's save, its files and its backups.
Shell.NoActivity: Nothing has happened yet in this session.
Shell.PlayTooltip: Host this world: SaveHarbor gets the group's newest version, marks the world as in use so nobody else hosts it, and starts the game.
Shell.JoinTooltip: Only starts the game, so you can join a friend who is hosting. Nothing is synced or locked.
Shell.NoDetails: Details appear here when a world is selected and its save can be read.
Shell.NoWorldBackups: No backups of this world yet.
Shell.SettingsTooltip: Your name, save folder, backups and appearance.
Settings.PlayerNameHint: Shown on sessions and shared versions. Leave empty to use your Windows user name. Friends now see:
Settings.ResetTooltip: Use the game's default save folder again.
Settings.BackupFolderTooltip: Open the folder with every backup SaveHarbor made of this game.
Settings.KeepBackupsHint: Older SaveHarbor backups of this game are deleted automatically. The newest backup of every world, recent safety backups and backups of removed worlds are always kept. Your world files are never touched.
Settings.ProviderHint: SaveHarbor Cloud keeps your group's worlds in the SaveHarbor project on Supabase. Google Drive uses a shared folder in your group's Drive.
Settings.InviteCodeOwnerHint: Anyone with this code can join your group.
Settings.InviteCodeMemberHint: Ask the group owner for the code.
Settings.InviteCodeRotateTooltip: Make a new invite code. The old one stops working; members stay in the group.
Settings.StorageUsedHint: All shared versions of your group's worlds, both games together.
Settings.CleanUpTooltip: Find files in the cloud that belong to no shared version, for example after an interrupted upload, and delete them after you confirm.
Settings.LeaveGroupHint: You no longer see the group's worlds. Worlds on this PC and their backups are not touched.
Settings.DeviceLabelHint: Shown with your sessions. Leave empty to use the Windows computer name. Friends now see:
Settings.SharedFolderHint: The folder your group uses for this game.
Settings.KeepSharedVersionsHintCloud: Older versions of a world are removed after your uploads. The latest version and any version a session is based on are always kept. Removed versions cannot be restored.
Settings.KeepSharedVersionsHint: Older versions of a world in the shared folder are removed after your uploads. The latest version and any version a session is based on are always kept. On Google Drive, removed versions go to the Drive trash for 30 days.
Settings.AmbientEffectsHint: Slowly drifting embers in the background.
Settings.TroubleshootingHint: Useful when you report a problem.
Inspector.Title: ALL WORLD INFO
Inspector.ShowFileTooltip: Open the save folder with this world's file selected.
Inspector.GameCopyTitle: The game keeps its own backup copy of this world
Inspector.GameCopyHint: If the world is damaged or a save went wrong, you can put this copy back. SaveHarbor shows how it compares and backs up your current copy first.
Inspector.HealthHint: See Save health below for what SaveHarbor found and what it means.
Inspector.KeepWorldTooltip: You checked the world in the game and it is right: remember its current files as the good state.
Inspector.MoveLeftoversTooltip: Moves the unfinished copies out of the game's save folder into SaveHarbor's data folder. Nothing is deleted.
Inspector.PrivacyNote.Dragonwilds: The world password and owner ID are never read or shown.
Inspector.PrivacyNote.Windrose: Only the world is shared. Characters and accounts stay on this PC and are only counted.
Update.RestartTooltip: Close SaveHarbor, install the update and start the new version.
Update.LaterTooltip: Hide this until the next update. The update installs when you close SaveHarbor.
Settings.UpdatesHint: SaveHarbor looks for new versions on GitHub every 6 hours and installs them when you restart or close it. GitHub sees only your IP address.
Settings.UpdatesUnavailable: Updates are available in the installed version.
